title: Your Memory Card Can Lie to You and Still Pass Every Check
excerpt: A photographer bought six SanDisk cards from Amazon and eBay and all six were fake. They looked right, they recorded, and they would have failed when it mattered most. Here is how to test yours before a paid shoot does it for you.

title: A Film Look Is a Recipe, Not a Camera. Recipes Do Not Transfer Cleanly
excerpt: A Nikon Zf owner who also shoots a Fujifilm X-H1 built a custom picture control to fake Classic Chrome and got close, but not exact. The gap is the lesson: color starts at the sensor, not at the preset.

title: Culling Is Where Your Taste Gets Trained. Do Not Automate It Away
excerpt: Imagen's Intelligent Studio removes the fixed cull-then-edit order and lets you search, select, and adjust with a single prompt. For a pro drowning in 20,000 frames that is relief. For a learner still forming judgment, the order was the lesson.
